title: Vitamin-D–phosphate coupling does not establish incremental PTH prediction across two NHANES recruitment datasets
abstract: A standardized25OHD × phosphate product did not establish incremental contemporaneous logPTH prediction beyond nonlinear conventional measures in exploratory NHANES2003–2004 to2005–2006 transfer (3,772 source;3,781 target adults): weighted MSE difference -0.000004539 logPTH², jointPSU-bootstrap95% interval [-0.00026221,0.00073289].
